model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect across various language families for different models. The horizontal axis lists the language families in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," has a scale ranging from 0 to 30, with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars for each language family, with each group consisting of bars for seven different models: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (light pink), XLM-B2 (red), and an additional uncolored or unlabeled model is not present as per the legend provided. The bars for each model within a language family vary in height, indicating different effect values; for instance, in the IE-Indic family, the approximate values are around 5 for mBERT-L2, 15 for XLM-L2, 20 for mBERT-R2, 20 for XLM-R2, 20 for mBERT-B2, and 20 for XLM-B2, while in the Semitic family, the values are roughly 5 for mBERT-L2, 5 for XLM-L2, 0 for mBERT-R2, 5 for XLM-R2, 15 for mBERT-B2, and 20 for XLM-B2. Each bar has an error bar extending above and below it. The bars are not sorted in any specific order within their groups, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding according to the model.
